title: Scientific Unit and Conversion Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Dimensional definitions, conversion rules, precision, and validation examples for scientific units. The Scientific Unit and Conversion Database is the reference that stops unit errors before they crash spacecraft: every unit defined by its dimensions, exact conversion factors, precision rules, and worked validation examples. SI base units, derived units, imperial, astronomical, and domain units (electronvolts, parsecs, decibels) each get a full record — because the Mars Climate Orbiter was lost to a pound-second vs newton-second mix-up, and this database exists so that never happens again.

title: Scientific Unit and Conversion Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. SI base: meter (length), kilogram (mass), second (time), ampere, kelvin, mole, candela. Derived: newton = kg m/s^2, joule = kg m^2/s^2, watt = J/s, pascal = N/m^2, volt = W/A. Exact definitions: 1 inch = 0.0254 m exactly; 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg exactly; 1 eV = 1.602176634e-19 J exactly. Dimensional analysis: every term in an equation must share dimensions; arguments to transcendentals (exp, sin, log) must be dimensionless. Precision: conversions preserve significant figures; chained conversions accumulate rounding — track with interval or significant-figure arithmetic. Temperature: offsets (Celsius/Fahrenheit) need affine, not linear, conversion: F = C*9/5+32.

demo.code: const crypto=require('crypto');function h(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex').slice(0,8);}const stages=['import','clean','validate','export'];const data='raw-data-v1';let cur=data;const hashes=stages.map(s=>{cur=s+':'+cur;return s+'='+h(cur);});const replay=(()=>{let c=data;return stages.map(s=>{c=s+':'+c;return s+'='+h(c);});})();J({hashes:hashes.length,replayMatch:JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay)});assert(JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay),'replay');
